intendedObjective: Create a readable walking-group account that honestly presents conflicting dates and explanations.
acceptableEditScope: Organize and clarify the evidence while retaining unresolved differences and withholding unsupported responsibility assignments.
stableFactsAndClaims: The report lists September 3 as the first public reopening; an attached notice says closure lasted until September 10.
The report does not explain whether dates concern different hours, sections, or a reversed reopening.
The contractor attributes delay to a missing inspection signature; the council says the signature was filed and attributes delay to incomplete barrier removal.
Neither summary includes the inspection sheet or barrier removal log.
One member recalls crossing September 5; another recalls the east entrance locked that evening.
The bundle does not establish a single sequence; both recollections may be accurate.
requiredForm: Readable short account for the walking group.
ambiguity: Actual reopening sequence and reason for delay remain unresolved.
The reason the two resident recollections differ is unknown.
missingPropositions: Evidence establishing a single sequence or responsibility is absent.
voiceConstraints: Neutral attribution, accessible wording, explicit uncertainty.
